A share is the part of the distinct values a pattern takes: exact when the scan held every distinct value, sample when it held a sample of them. A value counts for one pattern: the one of its family that has its lengths. Quoted text is a constant the pattern folds. Validated on every value is the second pass: how many occurrences of the whole file the pattern reads, exactly; a value no pattern reads is an observation of structure, not an error.

Counts are exact: every row of the file is placed in one category and one class, or counted as left out. The dominant class of a category is the one that holds most of it; a tie goes to the first class listed. Purity is the share of the classified rows that sit in the dominant class of their category. The score is Cramér's V corrected for the number of rows and classes; when the expected counts are low it is marked unstable and given no strength. An empty other row or column is not printed. Correlations show a linear association between two columns, over the rows where both have a number.

17 / Method

Analysis settings

Rules used for this analysis, so the result can be reproduced.

Scope
All 100,000 records
Missing values
absent, null, empty, blank, marker; markers: "N/A" "NULL"
Marker comparison
Whitespace trimmed; case-sensitive
Value normalization
Unicode composition (NFC): enabled; trim: enabled; collapse internal whitespace: enabled; comparison also with case folding: enabled, accents removed: enabled. Raw preview values are preserved.
Duplicate comparison
Exact raw values across every column; up to 2,000,000 distinct records compared
Type inference
At least 95.0% agreement across present values; numbers with dot or comma decimals, configured dates and true/false. Leading-zero identifiers remain text.
Date detection
Orders: YMD, MDY, DMY; separators: "-" "/" "." ; month names: en, fr; ambiguous order: unresolved, column evidence shown but never applied
Column types
The technical type, a detector matching at least 95.0% of present values, the length of the texts, the name of the column and, when the second pass counted them, the exact distinct values
Adaptive detection
Every detector on the first 10,000 distinct values of each column; detectors that recognized none of them, or at most 0.1% of them and none of the last 5,000, then skip the others, except about 1 value in 100. Number and date detection always test every value
Enumerations
At most 49 distinct values among at least 500 present values
Sensitive values
Shown in examples and the data sample
String lengths
Very short through 5; short through 20; medium through 50; long through 255; otherwise very long. Up to 10 examples per length are retained when the maximum is 50 or less.
Value representation
Complete through 50 distinct values; otherwise a reproducible sample of up to 100 distinct values, the ones with the smallest hash priorities
Row numbering
Data records start at 1, excluding the header. Quoted multiline values count as one record.
Row sample
The scan kept the first 50 records, up to 900 records drawn from the interior by a seeded hash, and the last 50; this report shows 10 at the start, 10 sampled and 10 at the end; raw values preserved
Patterns
Inferred from the sampled distinct values: up to 128 per column, values up to 64 characters, at least 2 distinct values per pattern
Observations
Rules version 2; at most 1,000 findings and 1,000 limits listed
JSON format
